subject: Alignment: Marketplace pricing checklist, seller margin allocation, and pre-signature evidence
messages:
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@greenleafhealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@greenleafhealth.com
Date: 2026-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private offer inquiry & pricing info request

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo this week — the team at GreenLeaf liked the inference latency profile and the Dedicated + Private deployment options. Procurement asked me to collect a couple of things before legal drafts a PO:

- A draft private offer showing list price, committed tier discounts, and any onboarding credits.
- The recommended reseller / channel commission percentage you expect Redwood to allow (we may route through HealthPartners Resale).
- Evidence we can attach to our procurement packet: short SOC2 summary (or link) and a one-page explanation of how channel invoicing/credits will appear on customer invoices.

Can you send a checklist and a draft private offer? Our timeline is aggressive — aiming to sign within 2 weeks.

Attachments: GreenLeaf_Procurement_Form_20260410.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Alice Monroe
Senior Procurement Manager
GreenLeaf Health
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer inquiry & pricing info request

Hi Alice — great to hear the demo resonated.

We can definitely get a draft private offer and the checklist over today. Quick clarifying Qs so we tailor the draft:

1) Which marketplace do you prefer for the private offer (AWS/GCP/Azure)? Pricing and SKU mapping differ slightly.
2) Will HealthPartners Resale be the invoiced reseller, or do you want Redwood to invoice GreenLeaf directly and pay HealthPartners separately?
3) Are there minimum committed monthly node-hours or a multi-month commit you expect?

Planned deliverables (today / tomorrow):
- Pricing_Workbook_GreenLeaf.xlsx (SKU mapping + tiered discount table)
- Draft private offer PDF with list price, committed tiers, and recommended reseller commission options
- SOC2 summary + short note on invoice flow for channel transactions

If you confirm marketplace and reseller model I’ll loop in Jordan for the SKU mapping and Laura for channel commission guidance.

Thanks,
David Kim
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Pricing_Workbook_GreenLeaf.xlsx (Excel)
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@greenleafhealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@greenleafhealth.com
Date: 2026-04-12T08:29:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer inquiry & pricing info request

Thanks David — sorry for the delay.

We prefer GCP marketplace for licensing. GreenLeaf would like Redwood to invoice us directly; HealthPartners will appear as a reseller on our side and receive commissions via a reseller agreement with us (not routed through Redwood). That said, procurement still needs to see the channel-margin guidance so we can validate total cost to GreenLeaf vs net to HealthPartners.

We expect a 12-month commitment but want month-to-month invoicing. Target committed baseline is roughly equivalent to 4,000 node-hours/month.

Procurement also asked for SOC2 Type II evidence and a short note about how reseller commission will be reflected (line item vs off-invoice credit).

Alice

Attachments: GreenLeaf_Compliance_Checklist.pdf (PDF)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-12T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Channel margin & markup options for GreenLeaf (internal)

Team — quick internal note before we send the formal draft to GreenLeaf:

- Proposed reseller guidance: provide two options in the private offer doc: (A) 10% standard reseller commission (off-invoice credit to reseller, Redwood invoices GreenLeaf at net price); (B) 5% reseller commission + one-time $25k implementation credit to accelerate buy-in (keeps long-term net price closer to list but gives reseller cash to cover onboarding).
- GCP mapping: Jordan, map the most common node-hour SKUs to our SKU families and include estimated token rates. Laura/Camila, include a small section explaining how off-invoice credits would appear in the invoice reconciliation (we typically show net invoice + separate commission memo).
- Evidence: attach SOC2 summary & a single-page 'channel billing flow' diagram.

I ran the pricing workbook (conservative scenario) — I can attach the internal calc if helpful.

Laura Bennett
Director, Partner Sales — Redwood Inference
Attachments: Internal_Pricing_Calc_GreenLeaf.xlsx (Confidential)
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-13T11:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer inquiry & pricing info request

Hi Alice — attaching the materials we discussed. Key points below.

Attachments: GreenLeaf_PrivateOffer_Draft_20260411.pdf (PDF), Pricing_Workbook_GreenLeaf.xlsx (Excel), Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (PDF)

Summary (high level):
- Marketplace: GCP. Draft maps our node-hour SKUs to recommended private-offer SKUs and shows list pricing.
- Commit: 12 months, 4,000 node-hours/month baseline used for committed-tier pricing.
- Reseller options (we included both):
  * Option A — 10% reseller commission (off-invoice credit). Redwood invoices GreenLeaf at net after commission; commission recorded in a separate memo for GreenLeaf/HealthPartners reconciliation.
  * Option B — 5% reseller commission + $25,000 one-time implementation credit applied as a pre-paid service credit on the first invoice. This keeps recurring net price slightly higher but provides reseller cash for onboarding services.
- Evidence: SOC2 summary attached (redacted) and a one-page channel-billing-note describing invoice layout.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm which reseller option you prefer (A or B) and whether the $25k implementation credit is acceptable if you choose B.
2) If the draft looks good I can issue a DocuSign-ready private offer and share a HubSpot deal link so procurement can route PO approvals.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890
Pricing workbook (live): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/abc123

If you prefer a quick call to walk through the workbook I’m free tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
David Kim
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@greenleafhealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@greenleafhealth.com, reseller@healthpartners.com
Date: 2026-04-14T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer inquiry & pricing info request

Thanks David — this is very helpful.

GreenLeaf prefers Option B (5% + $25k implementation credit). Procurement will need the final draft with the credit language and a short statement that the reseller commission is handled as an off-invoice credit to HealthPartners and will not change the invoice total for GreenLeaf (we need the memo text to attach).

Please send the DocuSign-ready private offer and the short channel-billing memo. Once we have those two docs procurement will route the PO internally; target is to return a signed PO within 5 business days.

Best,
Alice Monroe
Senior Procurement Manager
GreenLeaf Health
